1: // Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 40, w: 30, h: 20, speed: 5 };
13:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, fire: false };
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   const lasers = [];
16:   let score = 0;
17:   let lastFire = 0;
18:   const fireCooldown = 300; // ms
19:   let gameOver = false;
20: 
21:   // Input handling
22:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
23:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = true;
24:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = true;
25:     if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Spacebar') keys.fire = true;
26:   });
27:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
28:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = false;
29:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = false;
30:     if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Spacebar') keys.fire = false;
31:   });
32: 
33:   function spawnAsteroid() {
34:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
35:     const x = Math.random() * (width - radius * 2) + radius;
36:     const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
37:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, speed });
38:   }
39: 
40:   function fireLaser() {
41:     const now = Date.now();
42:     if (now - lastFire < fireCooldown) return;
43:     lastFire = now;
44:     lasers.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y - ship.h / 2, w: 2, h: 10, speed: 7 });
45:   }
46: 
47:   function update() {
48:     if (gameOver) return;
49: 
50:     // Move ship
51:     if (keys.left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
52:     if (keys.right) ship.x += ship.speed;
53:     // Clamp ship within canvas
54:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.w / 2, Math.min(width - ship.w / 2, ship.x));
55: 
56:     // Fire laser
57:     if (keys.fire) fireLaser();
58: 
59:     // Update lasers
60:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
61:       const l = lasers[i];
62:       l.y -= l.speed;
63:       if (l.y + l.h < 0) lasers.splice(i, 1);
64:     }
65: 
66:     // Update asteroids
67:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const a = asteroids[i];
69:       a.y += a.speed;
70:       // Remove if off screen
71:       if (a.y - a.r > height) {
72:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
73:         score += 1; // surviving asteroid gives point
74:         continue;
75:       }
76:       // Collision with ship
77:       if (
78:         a.x + a.r > ship.x - ship.w / 2 &&
79:         a.x - a.r < ship.x + ship.w / 2 &&
80:         a.y + a.r > ship.y - ship.h / 2
81:       ) {
82:         gameOver = true;
83:         break;
84:       }
85:       // Collision with lasers
86:       for (let j = lasers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
87:         const l = lasers[j];
88:         if (
89:           l.x > a.x - a.r && l.x < a.x + a.r &&
90:           l.y < a.y + a.r && l.y + l.h > a.y - a.r
91:         ) {
92:           // Destroy asteroid and laser
93:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
94:           lasers.splice(j, 1);
95:           score += 5;
96:           break;
97:         }
98:       }
99:     }
100: 
101:     // Randomly spawn asteroids (avg 1 per 60 frames)
102:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
103:   }
104: 
105:   function draw() {
106:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
107:     // Draw ship (triangle)
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
109:     ctx.beginPath();
110:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.h / 2);
111:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
112:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
113:     ctx.closePath();
114:     ctx.fill();
115: 
116:     // Draw asteroids
117:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
118:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
119:       ctx.beginPath();
120:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
121:       ctx.fill();
122:     });
123: 
124:     // Draw lasers
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
126:     lasers.forEach(l => {
127:       ctx.fillRect(l.x - l.w / 2, l.y, l.w, l.h);
128:     });
129: 
130:     // Draw score
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
132:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
133:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
134: 
135:     if (gameOver) {
136:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
137:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
138:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
139:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
140:       ctx.font = '32px monospace';
141:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
142:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
143:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
144:     }
145:   }
146: 
147:   function loop() {
148:     update();
149:     draw();
150:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
151:   }
152: 
153:   // Start game loop
154:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155: })();

(End of file - total 155 lines)
</content>
